name: kinematic-zapier
description: Zapier CLI integration for Kinematic CRM — lets non-technical Kinematic admins push leads from Typeform, Google Sheets, Calendly, Mailchimp and ~7000 other Zapier-connected apps straight into their Kinematic CRM, by wrapping the existing Generic Webhook integration (POST /api/v1/integrations/webhook/generic-webhook/:id?key=...).
